title: Monotonicity of the number of functions determined by additive relations
outcome: The literal unrestricted MathDB count conjecture is false: E={1} and two real-valued arithmetic functions give counts 1 at k=2 and 2 at k=3. The cited manuscript does not contain the stated conjecture.
novelty: Elementary corpus-statement correction with source-attribution mismatch; no claim to resolve a conjecture in Park or a restricted multiplicative-function problem.
